TC_E01.title: The Unmapped Path
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.description: Your compass points into a stone wall. A breeze escapes its seams. Beyond it is a mark in your own hand: Do not turn left the second time. You found your carving knife only this morning.
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.ENTER.title: Cross the wall
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.ENTER.descr: Lose 5 HP. Gain 35 Gold. You may leave afterward. Requires more than 5 HP.
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.DEEPER.desc: Lose 7 more HP. Choose 1 of 3 Traveler cards, or skip. Keep earlier rewards. Requires more than 7 HP.
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.CURSE.title: Open the breezy door
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.CURSE.descr: Obtain the curse Homeward. Then choose 60 Gold and 12 HP healing, or 1 of 3 rare Traveler cards. Keep earlier rewards.
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.RARE.title: Take the techniques
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.RARE.descri: Choose 1 of 3 rare Traveler cards. You may skip.
TC_E01.pages.CAMP.description: The fire is warm. A cup is half full. A map shows the wall you crossed, then a door, then another Spire beyond it. Your name occupies the night watch roster.
TC_E01.pages.DOOR.description: Wind whispers through the final door. Your compass points behind you. A note hangs from the handle: Take the way home with you, so you do not get lost again.
TC_E01.pages.TREASURE.description: There is no sky beyond the door, only the familiar entrance. A travel bag rests at your feet. Its contents have real weight, like the way home you now carry. Take one gift.
TC_E01.pages.DONE.description: The rewards remain in your pack. A fresh mark reads: Do not turn left the second time. You put away your knife. Fresh stone dust clings to its edge.
TC_E01.pages.LEAVE.description: You retrace your steps. The needle rests. Another set of footsteps behind the wall follows one step late. You keep what you have found.
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAVE.title: Leave with your gains
TC_E01.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAVE.descr: Keep everything already gained. Pay no further cost.
TC_E02.title: The Misaligned Survey
TC_E02.select: Choose 1 Attack, Skill, or Power with no element
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.description: The survey table lights itself. Wind, stone, and lightning point to different doors, each opening onto the same Spire. A strip reads: One of your elements does not belong to you. The next line offers a free first calibration.
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.FREE.title: First calibration
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.FREE.descri: Give 1 non-elemental Attack, Skill, or Power an element of your choice for this run. Free.
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.PAID.title: Second calibration
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.PAID.descri: Pay 60 Gold to modify another non-elemental card. Requires an eligible card and enough Gold.
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.WIND.title: Wind
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.WIND.descri: Give the selected card Wind for this run. Keep its cost, effects, and upgrades.
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.ROCK.title: Stone
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.ROCK.descri: Give the selected card Stone for this run. Keep its cost, effects, and upgrades.
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.THUNDER.des: Give the selected card Lightning for this run. Keep its cost, effects, and upgrades.
TC_E02.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAVE.title: End the survey
TC_E02.pages.ELEMENT.description: Three needles hover over the card. Choose a direction. Fine print warns: This device does not guarantee that any direction leads outside.
TC_E02.pages.CALIBRATED.description: The first needle settles. Elemental light fills the card. The strip reads: Address corrected. You thought this was a survey instrument. A second service costs 60 Gold.
TC_E02.pages.DONE.description: Two cards carry new light. The table prints a receipt already bearing your signature. The location of the exit remains blank.
TC_E02.pages.LEAVE.description: You gather your deck. Behind you the table repeats: Calibration complete. Exit location unknown.
TC_E03.title: A Letter from Outside
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.description:
A courteous postman checks your name beside a sealed door. The letter describes what just happened to you. Its watermark is a door with another Spire beyond.
“Did I send it?”
“Your signature is here.”
“I only arrived today.”
He carefully crosses out the date. “Then we were early. Sorry for the inconvenience.”
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.options.SIGN.title: Sign: Outside Letter
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.options.SIGN.descri: For this run, lose 2 HP at each combat start. Heal 3 HP after first receiving all three different combo rewards in that combat; turns may differ.
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.options.VERIFY.desc: Each combat, add a random unupgraded elemental Traveler reward card to hand with Ethereal and free cost this turn. Draw 1 fewer card on the first turn.
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.options.BUY.title: Trade: Unclaimed Mail
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.options.BUY.descrip: Normal combat card rewards have 1 extra option. Each card taken costs 15 Gold; cannot take without enough Gold. Skipping grants 10 Gold.
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAVE.title: Decline the contract
TC_E03.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAVE.descr: Gain no contract and pay no cost.
TC_E03.pages.DONE.description: The postman folds the contract. “Postage is payable by the recipient. Why you are also the sender requires a separate inquiry.” Beneath the crossed-out address you can still read: Outside the Spire.
TC_E03.pages.LEAVE.description: “Of course you may refuse. Please sign to confirm you never received this letter.” Your signature is already there. The postman files the form and wishes you a pleasant journey.
TC_E04.title: The Last Guide
TC_E04.pages.INITIAL.description: The old surveyor sees your compass and makes room. “Back so soon?” His map shows a door, then another Spire. He opens a toolbox. “One tool, as before. No charge. You paid before setting out.”
TC_E04.pages.INITIAL.options.NAIL.title: Wall-Piercing Nail
TC_E04.pages.INITIAL.options.NAIL.descri: Free: The first Stone-Lightning follow-up hit each turn applies 1 Vulnerable to its target.
TC_E04.pages.INITIAL.options.SPOOL.title: Echo Spool
TC_E04.pages.INITIAL.options.SPOOL.descr: Free: The first actual Wind-Stone reward each turn applies 1 Weak to a random living enemy.
TC_E04.pages.INITIAL.options.WATCH.title: Reverse Watch
TC_E04.pages.INITIAL.options.WATCH.descr: Free: +1 combo limit per turn for this run: 4 normally, 5 with either compass. Does not accumulate between turns.
TC_E04.pages.DONE.description: “Walls are thinner than they look. Tie the way back securely. You have another chance.” He closes the box. Three remarks for three travelers, yet only your footprints cross the map.
TC_E04.pages.LEAVE.description: You pack the tool and continue.
TC_MAIL.select: Take: pay 15 Gold. Skip: gain 10 Gold.
TC_MAIL.reward: Card reward: costs 15 Gold / skip for 10 Gold
